rationale: The answer abstains and shows the executed CAPEC query, but that query follows out(CAN_PRECEDE) from CAPEC-607 rather than retrieving patterns that can precede CAPEC-607. It therefore omits the expected related item, "Data Spill When information is handled by an information system of a classification/sensitivity for which the system has not been authorized to handle." No false cross-source mapping is asserted, so the abstention is partially acceptable but incomplete.
